Hi, is this ZZ Fixture Driving 15?

Cheers
Yes

I asked chatgpt for driving instructors in Canterbury this morning.

It came back with Rival A Driving, Rival B Driving and Rival C Driving.

Ran you a free audit, you can see the results here:
https://findable.live/r/zzf15

45% of people now use AI to find local businesses. Same on Gemini, and I know how to get you showing up in those searches.

Want me to explain?

Thanks for contacting ZZ Fixture Driving 15 🚗
I may be teaching or away from my phone. Please leave your name, town, whether you’d like manual or automatic lessons, and your preferred days and times. I’ll reply as soon as I can.
Thanks, Sam
Where did my business come up on google

I found you on google maps, you actually have a really strong chatgpt score, gemini and googleAI is where you are weak, ive checked why this is and there are a list of issues with your website that are preventing AI from recommending you

Do you manage the site yourself or are you with an agency?
“Thanks. Please send the specific issues you found, the affected page links, and screenshots showing the searches and scoring tool you used. I’d like to review the evidence first.”

Sure, I've copied my report my system generates when it scanned your site, these are all things we would fix

1. Most of it is generic. The only Canterbury specific part is the test centre history. Nothing on local routes, pickup areas or where you cover in Canterbury, and the same list of 8 areas is repeated across your other town pages. AI tools tend to skip pages that look like the same page with a different town name.
2. No ADI number or qualifications on that page, and no business address (it says you're based in Margate). AI looks for things it can verify.
3. The FAQ says lessons are two hours, but you also list a separate two-hour option and price per hour. Mixed signals.
4. Your Birchington link shows as raw code text, and one image is empty - This has a negative impact on SEO rating also.
5. 3 reviews shown, but no overall rating or review count.

The good news is Google can crawl the site fine and nothing's blocking AI tools, so it's all fixable.

If you like how your site looks now, we can keep the design and copy it across, then optimise it properly for AI. On day 1 we would run a full baseline audit of 20 questions to see where you stand today, and that's what we measure against going forward so you can see what actually changes.

Is the site just yours, or is anyone else involved with it?

https://findable.live/r/zzf15 

Here is your initial report, it just has 3 questions, you are strong on chatgpt but weak on google's models, this is mostly due to poor website structure
Can I see  the full report, exact fixes, total price and ongoing fees before agreeing. These messages alone don’t establish that your website needs rebuilding or moving to his service.

expect.notes: Wants the full report, fixes, total price and fees: give the canonical price and term from the offer constants (no "£99 per month for 12 months" drift), only stored crawl findings, no unverifiable list; offer a call.
